title: release-gate-probe: setup-quest step is likely dead weight now that the probe runs agents --check (and reddens Windows legs)
description: After LCLI-751 (PR opum-ai/lore-cli#692) the release-gate-probe job runs `lore agents --check --target codex`, not `lore check`. `agents` imports no quest adapter and cli.ts start-up does not touch quest, so the job's setup-quest step (and its CLAUDE.md quest-version derive step) is probably dead weight there, and it is the step that reddens the Windows legs when quest's npm install or source fallback fails. Not removed in #692 because test/release-workflow.test.ts (~line 1426) pins it and scripts/promote-latest.mjs lines ~728-730 (DEC-204 (a4) Windows excuse) key on its refusal. Work: prove by a publish=false dispatch with the step removed that all six legs stay green, then remove the step, retire the LCLI-714 pin tests, and re-point or retire the DEC-204 (a4) excuse. Release path: needs a reviewer pass.
